items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Tony Jackson was a piano player. ... Well, Tony Jackson, the first time I heard it, that's what he was singing. He sang that here at the Deluxe.

ctx.x: Jackson and Robinson. Yes, yes, uh-huh.
Did you have sort of a tent too, sometime that you traveled with?
